detail.title: INTEX AIR KING HC 60 Air Cooler – 60 Litres
detail.overview: Long Air Throw | Multi-directional cooling | Inverter-compatible | Ice Chamber | 1-Year Warranty The Intex Air King HC 60 Desert Air Cooler is engineered to deliver powerful and dependable cooling for mid-sized rooms and everyday living spaces where consistent airflow and efficiency are essential. With its 3-speed setting, it ensures strong air circulation that reaches every corner of the room, creating a refreshing and comfortable indoor environment even during peak summer conditions. With a 60-litre water tank, the Air King HC 60 supports long, uninterrupted cooling hours, reducing the need for frequent refills and making it suitable for extended daily use. The cooler is equipped with advanced 3-side honeycomb cooling pads, which enhance water retention and evaporation, resulting in faster cooling and more effective temperature reduction. For days when the heat is especially intense, the dedicated ice chamber allows users to amplify the cooling effect instantly. Built for durability and long-term performance, the Air King HC 60 features a shock- and rust-proof body that withstands daily wear and seasonal use. Its inverter-compatible motor ensures uninterrupted comfort during power cuts and voltage fluctuations, making it a reliable choice for Indian summer conditions. Combining strong cooling performance, energy efficiency, and a robust build, the Air King HC 60 stands out as a practical and powerful desert air cooler for modern homes. Product Highlights Large 60L Tank A well-sized tank for continuous cooling throughout the evening or workday with minimal refilling effort. Long Air Throw With an impressive air throw of up to 17 meters, this air cooler is ideal for living rooms, large bedrooms, offices, restaurants, and open spaces. Energy-Efficient & Inverter Compatible Designed to deliver powerful cooling while consuming less power, this air cooler is inverter compatible, so you stay cool even during power cuts or voltage fluctuations. High-Efficiency Honeycomb Cooling Pads The 3-sided Honeycomb cooling pads allow 45% extra water retention, which results in 25% extra cooling, making this cooler perfect for hot and dry climates. 3-Speed Fan & 4-Way Air Deflection Choose from three speed settings to suit your comfort. The 4-way air deflection system lets you adjust the airflow to suit your liking. Durable Build & Easy Mobility Featuring a double ball bearing motor, the cooler is built for long-lasting performance. 360° castor wheels make it easy to move across rooms with minimal effort. Ice Chamber Add ice or ice packs to enjoy extra cooling during peak summer heat, delivering a faster and more refreshing airflow when you need it most. Collapsible Louvres The fully collapsible louvres make cleaning simple and maintenance easy, helping maintain efficient cooling performance season after season. Water Level Indicator A quick glance lets you know exactly when it's time to refill the tank. Say goodbye to guesswork and ensure your cooling is never interrupted. Voltage Fluctuation T.O.P. Motor Cover Your cooler's motor is protected against sudden power surges and drops in voltage. This ensures safe, stable operation and extends the lifespan of your appliance. 1-year warranty Complete peace of mind with a 1-year manufacturer warranty, ensuring reliable performance and dependable after-sales support. Ideal For Large bedrooms, substantial living rooms, or medium-sized offices. They balance high capacity with ease of mobility, perfect for general home use in dry climates.
